## NHSBSA templates


| Template | Use it for | Where it is described |
|---|---|---|
| Analytical project record | Recording scope, data, method, assumptions, uncertainty, decisions and sign-off | [Deciding your assurance level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |
| Quality assurance checklist | The checks required at your assurance level | [Deciding your assurance level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |
| Quality assurance log | Recording checks as you do them, with what you found | [Deciding your assurance level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |
| Quality assurance statement | Telling readers what was done and what the limits are | [Phase 4, delivery and sign-off](../04-delivery-and-sign-off/index.qmd) |
| Assurance level decision sheet | Scoring impact and likelihood to reach your assurance level, and the Business Critical test | [Deciding your assurance level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |

The templates and the decision sheet are held on the NHSBSA SharePoint, alongside the rest of the
analytical documentation. **Opening them needs NHSBSA network access.** If you cannot reach them,
ask the Data Science, Advanced Analytics and Statistics team.

What matters is that a template is created in place rather than downloaded. Created in place, it is
versioned and can be linked from the output. Downloaded, filled in and saved somewhere, it is a
template nobody can find afterwards. The field lists are the part this playbook owns, so take
them wherever your team works.

## NHSBSA internal documents


Some of the sources named at the foot of these pages are NHSBSA's own documents rather than
published standards. They are held on the NHSBSA SharePoint and **need NHSBSA network access**.

| Document | What the playbook uses it for |
|---|---|
| Criteria for determining the level of analytical risk v3, 10 September 2026 | The assurance level decision sheet: the impact and likelihood scales, the matrix, and the worked examples. [Deciding your assurance level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |
| NHSBSA Business Critical Analysis: Navigating the Assurance Journey, 17 September 2026 | The Business Critical definition, the six criteria, and the documentation stack. [Business Critical analysis](../08-business-critical/index.qmd) |
| NHSBSA Analytical operating model and implementation plan, Summer 2026 | What NHSBSA counts as an analytical output, and the range it covers. [How to use this playbook](../00-how-to-use/index.qmd) |
| NHSBSA Analytical Risk Assessment and Quality Assurance Framework | What each risk rating asks for. [Deciding your assurance level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/index.qmd) |

If you cannot reach one of these, ask the Data Science, Advanced Analytics and Statistics team.

All analytical documentation should be stored centrally.

## NHSBSA guidance


| Resource | For |
|---|---|
| [NHSBSA Analytical Code Assurance Playbook](https://nhsbsa-data-analytics.github.io/nhsbsa-analytical-code-assurance-playbook) | Version control, testing, peer review, documentation and open sourcing of analytical code |
| [NHSBSA Data Science Playbook](https://nhsbsa-data-analytics.github.io/nhsbsa-data-science-playbook) | The workflow for a Data Science initiative, from problem definition to wrap up |
| [NHSBSA Data Visualisation Standards](https://nhsbsa.github.io/nhsbsa-digital-playbook/data/data-visualisation/) | Charts, tables and dashboards, and how to label them so they can be read |
| [NHSBSA Open Data Standards](https://github.com/nhsbsa-data-analytics/open-data-standards) | How NHSBSA publishes open data |
| [Coffee and Coding](https://github.com/nhsbsa-data-analytics/coffee-and-coding) | Monthly hands-on sessions. Materials from every session since 2021 |

## NHSBSA statistics policies


These bind official and national statistics. The behaviour they describe is worth following for any
published output. [Phase 4, delivery and sign-off](../04-delivery-and-sign-off/index.qmd) says where each one bites.

Both of these are published, so you do not need network access to read them.

| Policy | For |
|---|---|
| [NHSBSA Revisions and Corrections Policy](https://www.nhsbsa.nhs.uk/sites/default/files/2021-05/Revisions_and_Corrections_Policy_v002.pdf) | What counts as a revision and what counts as a correction, how errors are graded by consequence, and who decides |
| [NHSBSA Statistical Disclosure Control protocol](https://www.nhsbsa.nhs.uk/sites/default/files/2020-10/nhsbsa-sdc-protocol.pdf) | Thresholds and methods for protecting small counts in a published output |
